title: Traffic Stop On Man With A Felony Warrant For Assault Turns Into Chaos
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On January 21st, 2023. An officer was on routine patrol when he observed a man with a felony warrant driving in traffic. When the officers approached him he was very combative and refused to believe he had a warrant. He also refused to leave his car, forcing the officers to drag him out. When officers were telling him what warrants he had, he denied it and said he didn't recall assaulting a pregnant female. This is the body-cam footage of the events.
